title: Enchant Combiner Tweak
body:
Tweaks the enchantment combination logic to make more sense and be fairer, without being _too_ unbalanced (I hope).
Uses `ceil((smallerLevel/2)+biggerLevel)` to calculate the new level. (pardon my pseudocode)
This is my first mod, and I had to teach myself how to do it, so expect some minor bugs.
